projects.name: Moss Landing Phase III
projects.quote: Vistra currently has 3,408 MW of zero-emissiongeneration and energy storage online (including our 2,400-MWnuclear facility, Comanche Peak), with additional renewable generation and energy storage developments in the near-term pipeline, including the Moss Landing Phase III 350 MW energy storage development anticipated to be online mid-2023.

projects.name: Energy Harbor acquisition
projects.quote: In March 2023, Vistra announced the execution of a definitive agreement to acquire Energy Harbor, which will add more than 4,000 MW of nuclear generation to its portfolio along with approximately one million additional retail customers.
